proposals.title: Proposal Six: Elect Each Director Annually
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Company to declassify the Board so all directors are elected annually for one-year terms.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding reduction of director terms to one year.

proposals.title: Proposal Seven: Simple Majority Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to replace supermajority voting requirements in the charter and bylaws with a majority-of-votes-cast standard.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal for simple majority voting provisions in our governing documents.

proposals.title: Proposal Eight: Annual Reporting on Anti-Harassment and Discrimination Efforts
proposals.proponent: Comptroller of the State of New York, Trustee of the New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual public report quantifying the effectiveness of efforts to prevent harassment and discrimination against employees.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding annual reporting on anti-harassment and discrimination efforts.

proposals.title: Proposal Nine: Adoption of a Freedom of Association and Collective Bargaining Policy
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to adopt and disclose a non-interference policy upholding workers' freedom of association and collective bargaining rights.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding adoption of a freedom of association and collective bargaining policy.

proposals.title: Proposal Ten: Reporting on Effects and Risks Associated with Electromagnetic Radiation and Wireless Technologies
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on health effects and financial and competitive risks of electromagnetic radiation and wireless technologies in vehicles.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding reporting on effects and risks associated with electromagnetic radiation and wireless technologies.

proposals.title: Proposal Eleven: Adopting Targets and Reporting on Metrics to Assess the Feasibility of Integrating Sustainability Metrics into Senior Executive Compensation Plans
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Compensation Committee to adopt targets and report metrics on integrating sustainability and senior executive diversity metrics into executive pay.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding adopting targets and reporting on metrics to assess the feasibility of integrating sustainability metrics into senior executive compensation plans.

proposals.title: Proposal Twelve: Committing to a Moratorium on Sourcing Minerals from Deep Sea Mining
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Tesla to commit to a moratorium on sourcing minerals from deep sea mining, or disclose rationale and assess need for deep sea materials.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding committing to a moratorium on sourcing minerals from deep sea mining.
